name: Spanish to B1
summary: A six-month self-study plan to reach a B1 level in Spanish, with weekly reviews.
targetReason: Mostly conversation practice and planning, with scheduled weekly reviews; no code to run.
goal: Hold a 15-minute everyday conversation and pass a B1 mock exam within six months.
audience: An adult beginner studying about five hours a week.
deliverables: A vocabulary list organised by topic
A weekly review routine with a short progress log
constraints: About five hours a week, mostly on weekday evenings
doneWhen: A B1 mock exam is passed in all four skills
A 15-minute conversation on an everyday topic goes without switching language

files.purpose: Month-by-month study plan with goals for each month.
Vocabulary grouped by topic, with example sentences.

scheduledTasks.name: Weekly review
scheduledTasks.prompt: Run the review checklist in docs/PROGRESS.md for this week, then suggest the plan for next week.
